subcommands.build: Build the native binary (legacy classic build)
subcommands.customize: Generate native code to customize the project
subcommands.export: Export the static files of the app for hosting on a web server
subcommands.install: Install a package with proper version checking
subcommands.login: Log in to an Expo account
subcommands.logout: Log out of an Expo account
subcommands.prebuild: Generate native code for the project (Expo prebuild)
subcommands.publish: Deploy a project to Expo hosting
subcommands.register: Sign up for a new Expo account
subcommands.run:android: Build and run the Android app locally
subcommands.run:ios: Build and run the iOS app locally
subcommands.start: Start a local dev server for the app
subcommands.upgrade: Upgrade the project to a specific SDK version
subcommands.whoami: Show the currently logged-in Expo account
